Title: Announcing the Azure API Management publishing tool

Body.Content:
The Azure API Management Ingest Tool gives Visual Studio developers a one-click way to place REST APIs behind an Azure API Management instance. With API Management, you can manage, throttle, and understand the usage of your API endpoints. For more information and to get started, see Azure API Management Publishing Tool. Learn more about API Management

  • Managing your first API
